name: TOTP Enrollment Success
summary: An authenticated user explicitly begins time-based one-time password enrollment, configures an authenticator from the returned enrollment material, confirms possession with one valid generated code, enables MFA, and receives recovery codes on a dedicated destination view.
finalOutcome: TOTP is enabled for the current durable identity, the authenticator secret is stored securely, and a fresh set of recovery codes is displayed to the user on the dedicated recovery-code surface.

sourceReferences.note: BeginTotpEnrollmentAsync and ConfirmTotpEnrollmentAsync are modeled as two distinct server operations in separate scenarios.
Explicit user-facing entry point for the begin-enrollment operation.
Displays QR code and secret returned by successful begin enrollment.
Collects the single verification code used by the confirmation server operation.
Dedicated destination surface for recovery codes returned by successful confirmation.

Canonical enrollment uses simple stable screens rather than mutating one screen through workflow states. Each server-backed scenario contains one server operation and normally transitions to a new AuthView.
